correctness.rationale: The exact projection-area identity S(u)=max{4a,2(a+b+c)} on ordered absolute coordinates, together with the convex-hull criterion, isolates twelve minimizers at projected area 2sqrt(2). In a tangent chart the radial boundary is S=2sqrt(2)sqrt(1-r²)+r max(2sqrt(2)|cos phi|,2|sin phi|). A uniform positive slope permits Taylor inversion. The spherical chart Jacobian and independently evaluated angular integrals give equal epsilon² coefficient 3/(2sqrt(2)pi) for N=3 and N=4, and epsilon³ coefficients 7/(8pi) versus 5/(8pi). Their ratio yields triangular conditional slope +sqrt(2)/24. Local disjointness and remainders are uniform for sufficiently small positive surplus; finite hull/numerical tests are auxiliary.
